lines.text: It is
a.m. We are at the Burbank
Airport about to fly a jet company
called JetSuiteX.
We are going to San Francisco and then

my very first time going to Napa and we
are celebrating my birthday. It's also a
holiday weekend. We get some extra days
off of work.
You can see behind me the plane.
So the plane is starting to warm up. The
great thing about this company, we can
arrive 20 minutes before the flight and
we don't have to go through all the
security that you normally would at LAX,
which is the international airport in
Los Angeles.
We are in the rental car crossing over
the Bay Bridge. The Bay Bridge connects
Oakland to San Francisco. Still have
16 minutes left until we get into the
city. We are now going in the tunnel or
I guess under the tunnel. This is the
actual Bay Bridge that we are
approaching. We are driving about 15 to
25 mph.
I look very tired this morning.
Unfortunately, my dog was vomiting all
night. I had to get up several times in
the middle of the night. I actually
slept through my alarm. Luckily, my
husband woke me up at
a.m. We
quickly got ready to go to the airport.
Once we arrive in San Francisco, we are
going to check in to the hotel and drop

Francisco. Look at all of the tall
buildings. These types of buildings are
called skyscrapers.
Can you guess why?
San Francisco has a lot of hills.
There's history
with some pretty serious earthquakes. We
just received our brunch. I ordered
eggs sunny-side up,
avocado,
tomato, and this is

delicious-looking
avocado toast with pieces of bacon. He

fresh-squeezed
orange juice. We are at Stonemill

a plain matcha latte. It is about
at night.
And we are at the hotel room in San

walking around the city,
eating, drinking tea, exploring, and now
I just feel like crashing,
which is another way of saying I'm very
tired, and I don't feel like doing

going to do some edits tonight for some
